summary.text: Peter Kujawski is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired U.S. Army colonel and business executive, he ran for the same district in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Kujawski was born in Webster, Massachusetts, and served in the U.S. Army from 1979 to 2009, according to Ballotpedia.

He graduated from Bartlett High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Worcester Polytechnic Institute in 1979 and a graduate degree from Golden Gate University in 1983, and completed a military citation at the U.S. Army Command and General Staff College in 1992.

His career experience includes work as a business executive, manager, director, vice president and president, and his listed affiliations include the Bedford Republican Committee, the Knights of Columbus and the Military Officers Association of America.
Kujawski ran in the Republican primary for Hillsborough 2 in 2024, advancing to the general election, where he was not among the seven winners.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an engineer by degree, a business executive by trade and a retired Army colonel, and said he was then a 27-year resident of Bedford.
He listed national security, growing the economy, personal freedom and preserving what he called the New Hampshire Advantage as his policy interests.
